Done. `out/T4/model.safetensors` written with 160 tensors, 48 MLP tensors merged at λ=0.4.

**Approach:** `out/T4/solution.py` loads the three checkpoints into separate dicts, builds the 48 MLP key names explicitly (12 layers × {c_fc, c_proj} × {weight, bias}) rather than pattern-matching, then verifies the key sets are identical and every one of the 112 non-MLP tensors is bit-exactly equal across all three via `torch.equal`. The merge writes into a fresh output dict, so both task vectors are taken against the unmodified base. Guards fire on: key-set mismatch, MLP shape/dtype mismatch, any non-MLP divergence, merged count ≠ 48, output count ≠ 160, plus a read-back check that the written file has 160 tensors and reproduces the unchanged tensors bit-exactly.

**Executions:** 1, succeeded on the first run. `out/T4/REPORT.md` records the self-report fields.
